action.objective: Verify g6a6 (rook to a6) at full depth, checking king safety and whether Black can win material.
action.rationale: Broad search suggested g6a6 (exact 844 at depth 3), but all rows are bounded and no move is commit-ready. Reserved verification grants g6a6 2000 nodes at depth 4. Black's rook on b2 already occupies the 2nd rank and can capture c2, so I must confirm our king and c2-pawn hold after the rook lift. Rook moves also risk back-and-forth shuffling; a single-candidate search at max_depth is the required verification step before commit.
